question: Who among the following is/was a famous sitarist?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ravi Shankar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Ravi Shankar** was an Indian sitar virtuoso and a composer of Hindustani classical music.
 
• He was the best-known proponent of the sitar in the second half of the 20th century and influenced many musicians worldwide.
 
• Ravi Shankar collaborated with many international artists, including **George Harrison of The Beatles**, which helped to popularize Indian classical music in the West.
 
• He received numerous awards and honors
